subject: POC prompt lab — staging windows, load test timing & guardrails
messages:
From: Jenna Park <jenna@acme.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff — proposed windows for hands-on prompt lab and load test

Hi Evelyn / Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Acme is excited to move to a short POC so we can validate routing and throughput with our production prompt set. Two things we want to lock down so we can align internal stakeholders:

1) A 90–120 minute hands-on prompt lab (prompt inventory review + guardrail requirements + structured output samples).
2) A separate 2-hour load window to run parallel routing scenarios (steady-state + spikes) against a staging endpoint.

Our initial availability (PT):
- Nov 2, 10:00–12:30 or 14:00–16:30
- Nov 4, 09:00–11:30

If you can propose a preferred combination (lab first, then load window within 48 hours), that would help our ops team schedule env provisioning.

Attached: a short doc listing our high-level success criteria. I can share the prompt inventory this week once you send the template.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Jenna Park
Product Lead, Acme AI
jenna@acme.ai
+1 415-555-0192

Attachment: acme_success_criteria.pdf (stub)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna@acme.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed windows for hands-on prompt lab and load test

Hi Jenna — great to hear. Appreciate the windows. Proposed plan from our side:

- Hands-on prompt lab (90 mins): Nov 2, 10:00–11:30 PT. Agenda: 1) prompt inventory walk, 2) structured-output samples, 3) routing expectations and KV/cache implications, 4) quick guardrails checklist.
- Load window (2 hours): Nov 3, 14:00–16:00 PT — gives us an overnight to stage a routing variant and apply quantization profile on a clone.

Action items for Acme before the lab:
- Fill out the attached prompt_inventory_template.csv (high-level examples, expected max tokens, structured output fields).
- Call out any PII/QoS constraints so we can surface redaction/retention settings.

I attached an initial agenda (initial_agenda.md) and a draft load test plan (load_test_plan_v1.pdf) — these are draft, will iterate.

Can Karthik confirm the routing matrix template he prefers? I want routing decisions and fallback policies captured before the lab.

If that schedule looks good I’ll send calendar invites and include a short pre-read.

Best,

Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Attachment: prompt_inventory_template.csv, initial_agenda.md, load_test_plan_v1.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jenna Park <jenna@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed windows for hands-on prompt lab and load test

Thanks — schedule works for me. A couple of notes to prepare on our side so the lab is productive: 

- Structured output: please have Acme include 2–3 canonical JSON schemas for the outputs they expect (field names, types, required vs optional). We’ll build a short validator during the session.
- Routing: I attached a routing_matrix.xlsx as a starter. Request Acme annotate which prompts need strict latency (<300ms) vs quality-first. That will determine shard selection and batching profiles.
- Load plan tweak: can we move the load window to Nov 3, 13:30–15:30 PT? That gives ops an extra 30 minutes to finalize the staging key rotation.

Open items for the lab:
- Who will own structured-output sign-off on Acme’s side (name/email)?
- Any locked models or they want us to test both an LLaMA-variant and a quantized 4-bit variant?

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_prompt_lab — I’ll drop a versioned prompt set and the routing template there.

Attachment: routing_matrix.xlsx

-Karthik
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Jenna Park <jenna@acme.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed windows for hands-on prompt lab and load test

Evelyn / Karthik — that all works for us.

Confirming:
- Prompt lab: Nov 2, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Load window: Nov 3, 13:30–15:30 PT

I’ll have Carlos and I fill out the prompt inventory template by COB Monday and share the structured-output schemas.

Please send calendar invites and include the staging endpoint URL and a short pre-read. Also — can you add a short bullet in the agenda about how Redwood handles KV-cache invalidation when we test rapid prompt changes? That’s one of our internal questions.

Thanks — sending this to our ops now to lock the windows.

Best,

Jenna Park
Product Lead, Acme AI
